p95_latency_target: p95 < 120ms for chat; embeddings <= 350ms; aim for 50-80ms p50
throughput_target: 200-500 concurrent requests/sec at peak campaign events; steady-state ~80 rps
model_preferences: open LLM for cost control (7B-13B quantized)
fallback small quantized variant for heavy tails
option to route to higher-capacity model for critical flows
canary_rollout_plan: Start with 5% of production traffic to Dedicated pool (canary), monitor latency / errors / token cost for 72h. If metrics stable, increase to 25% over 48h, then 50% then full cutover. Canary includes model-variant tests: variant A (13B quantized) vs variant B (7B faster). Canary cutoff: sustained error rate >1% or p95 > 1.5x baseline -> automatic rollback to hosted.
fallback_routing_plan: Primary: Dedicated (preferred) in US-west; Fallback 1: Redwood Hosted in same region; Fallback 2: Dedicated in another region (us-east) for regional failover. Routing controlled by smart-routing policy with health checks every 30s. Automatic fallback on latency degradation or quota exhaustion. Route by request-tag (enterprise vs standard) + model capability mapping.
poc_success_criteria: SLO: p95 chat latency < 120ms on Dedicated under target load
Cost: average token cost on Dedicated <= 50% of hosted at equivalent quality
Quality: automated evals on 500 labelled prompts show no regression (>95% parity) vs hosted model
Reliability: no more than 1 rollback event during 2-week canary
pricing_expectation: Expect committed Dedicated MSRP discount vs hosted; target ARR band aligns to estimate ($150k-$400k). Wants clear per-token and per-hour GPU pricing + burst to hosted pricing.
